findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare_filing_costs · Private data: compare_filing_costs, estimate_taxes, tax_document_checklist, tax_deadlines, explain_tax_document · Public sink: compare_filing_costs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare_filing_costs · Private data: compare_filing_costs, estimate_taxes, tax_document_checklist, tax_deadlines, explain_tax_document · Public sink: compare_filing_costs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
